action_cards.title: Missing Critical Check: Newborn temperature checked (36.5-37.4C) and warmth/KMC verified
action_cards.summary: Postnatal Newborn Home Visit Checklist (HBNC) — critical check pending: Newborn temperature checked (36.5-37.4C) and warmth/KMC verified.
action_steps: Measure axillary temperature; initiate Kangaroo Mother Care if cold and escalate if <35.5C or >=37.5C.

action_cards.title: Missing Critical Check: Exclusive breastfeeding and effective latch observed
action_cards.summary: Postnatal Newborn Home Visit Checklist (HBNC) — critical check pending: Exclusive breastfeeding and effective latch observed.
action_steps: Observe a full feed; assist positioning and refer if infant feeds poorly or cannot suck.

action_cards.title: Missing Critical Check: Respiratory rate (<60/min) and no severe chest indrawing verified
action_cards.summary: Postnatal Newborn Home Visit Checklist (HBNC) — critical check pending: Respiratory rate (<60/min) and no severe chest indrawing verified.
action_steps: Count breaths for 1 full minute; refer urgently if >=60/min or severe chest indrawing.

action_cards.title: Missing Critical Check: Umbilical cord stump dry with no redness or pus
action_cards.summary: Postnatal Newborn Home Visit Checklist (HBNC) — critical check pending: Umbilical cord stump dry with no redness or pus.
action_steps: Advise keeping cord dry (no oils/ash); refer to PHC if umbilical redness or discharge.

action_cards.title: Missing Critical Check: Birth/visit weight recorded and LBW (<2.5 kg) flagged
action_cards.summary: Postnatal Newborn Home Visit Checklist (HBNC) — critical check pending: Birth/visit weight recorded and LBW (<2.5 kg) flagged.
action_steps: Weigh newborn; if <2.5 kg initiate KMC + frequent feeds + extra HBNC visits; if <1.8 kg refer to SNCU.

action_cards.title: Missing Critical Check: Checked for yellow palms/soles (jaundice) and normal limb activity
action_cards.summary: Postnatal Newborn Home Visit Checklist (HBNC) — critical check pending: Checked for yellow palms/soles (jaundice) and normal limb activity.
action_steps: Examine newborn in daylight; refer urgently if jaundice extends to palms/soles or baby is lethargic.
